arguments.command:
python -c '
import re

# Test the search regex patterns
patterns = {
    "default": "a (.+?) c",
    "left": "a ([^ ]+) * c", 
    "center": "a  *([^ ]+) * c"
}

for name, pattern in patterns.items():
    print(f"{name}: {pattern!r}")
    compiled = re.compile(pattern)
    
    # Test matches
    tests = [
        " a b c ",
        " a hello world c ",
        "   hello   world   c   ",
    ]
    for text in tests:
        m = compiled.search(text)
        if m:
            print(f"  \"{text}\" -> group(1)={m.group(1)!r}")
        else:
            print(f"  \"{text}\" -> NO MATCH")
    print()
'
